scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:hub" "npm run dev:browser"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @debugscope/hub
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @debugscope/hub && npm run typecheck --workspace @debugscope/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @debugscope/browser && npm run build --workspace debugscope-vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @debugscope/hub && npm run typecheck --workspace @debugscope/ui-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @debugscope/browser && npm run typecheck --workspace debugscope-vscode
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:hub && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:live && npm run build
